include_directories(
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/subsys
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/idl
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})

add_rpc_files(server ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/idl/eventlogrpc.idl)

# eventlog.exe is all Rust (eventlog-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/eventlog-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# eventlog.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/eventlog-rust/src/eventlog/eventlog.rs)
# eventsource.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/eventlog-rust/src/eventlog/eventsource.rs)
# logport.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/eventlog-rust/src/eventlog/logport.rs)
# rpc.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/eventlog-rust/src/eventlog/rpc.rs)
# file.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/eventlog-rust/src/eventlog/file.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(eventlog_shims OBJECT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/eventlogrpc_s.c)
target_link_libraries(eventlog_shims PRIVATE evtlib libadvapi32 librpcrt4 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(eventlog_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(eventlog_res OBJECT eventlog.rc)
target_compile_definitions(eventlog_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(eventlog_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(eventlog eventlog-cargo eventlog.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE eventlog-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS eventlog_shims eventlog_res xdk)
